exercises.detail: 15 min — Raise: 4-6 min easy movement. Mobilize: ankle rocks, leg swings, hip circles, walking lunge. Activate: glute bridge, band walk if available, A-march/A-skip, wall-switch drill. Potentiate: 2 x 30 m build-ups (about 60%, then 75%) and 1 x 20 m at about 85%; add one event-specific rehearsal.

exercises.name: Standing or sport-stance acceleration — 10 m
exercises.detail: 1 set · 4 reps · 10m — 90-95%; fast and repeatable. · 2-3 min between reps

exercises.name: Standing or sport-stance acceleration — 20 m
exercises.detail: 1 set · 4 reps · 20m — 90-95%; fast and repeatable. · 3-4 min between reps

exercises.name: Standing broad jump
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 2 reps — Full reset; stop when landing control drops.

exercises.name: Easy downshift
exercises.detail: 5 min — 3-8 min easy walk, breathing downshift, then brief comfortable mobility. Long static stretching is optional after the session, never forced.

exercises.name: Box jump or broad jump
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 3 reps — Full reset between quality reps. Beginners use a low box or controlled broad jump.

exercises.name: Back squat or trap-bar deadlift
exercises.detail: 4 sets · 5 reps — 3-4 sets of 3-6 controlled reps. Beginners use fewer sets and lighter loading.

exercises.name: Barbell or dumbbell RDL
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 6 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-8.

exercises.name: Loaded split squat
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 6 reps — 2-3 sets of 5-8 per side.

exercises.name: Bench press or dumbbell bench press
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 8 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-10.

exercises.name: Pull-up, pulldown, or row
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 8 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-10.

exercises.name: Loaded trunk circuit
exercises.detail: 2 sets · 8 min — 2-3 sets or 6-10 minutes.

schedule.restNote: No SprintLab speed session is scheduled. Team practice, coach work, and recovery still count as training demands.

workout.title: General Speed Low Support Day
workout.purpose: Keep a support day genuinely low while building rhythm, trunk capacity, and lower-leg strength.

exercises.name: Low-day warm-up
exercises.detail: 10 min — 5 min easy movement; dynamic ankle/hip mobility; marching, skipping, and two progressive strides that remain comfortably submaximal.

exercises.name: Relaxed stride
exercises.detail: 1 set · 6 reps · 60m — 65-75%; conversational and smooth. · Walk-back recovery

exercises.name: Lower-leg + trunk circuit
exercises.detail: 2 sets · 1 rep — Calf raise, bent-knee soleus raise, tibialis raise, dead bug, and side plank.

exercises.name: Easy downshift
exercises.detail: 5 min — 3-8 min easy walk, breathing downshift, then brief comfortable mobility. Long static stretching is optional after the session, never forced.

schedule.restNote: No SprintLab speed session is scheduled. Team practice, coach work, and recovery still count as training demands.

workout.title: General Acceleration Development + Force-Oriented Sprint Strength
workout.purpose: Develop longer, more forceful acceleration while preserving full recovery and repeatable mechanics. Paired with force-oriented sprint strength on the same high-output day.

exercises.name: RAMP sprint warm-up
exercises.detail: 15 min — Raise: 4-6 min easy movement. Mobilize: ankle rocks, leg swings, hip circles, walking lunge. Activate: glute bridge, band walk if available, A-march/A-skip, wall-switch drill. Potentiate: 2 x 30 m build-ups (about 60%, then 75%) and 1 x 20 m at about 85%; add one event-specific rehearsal.

exercises.name: Varied-start acceleration — 20 m
exercises.detail: 1 set · 3 reps · 20m — 95-100%; fast and technically repeatable. · 3-4 min between reps

exercises.name: Varied-start acceleration — 30 m
exercises.detail: 1 set · 4 reps · 30m — 95-100%; continue pushing through the transition. · 4-5 min between reps

exercises.name: Repeated broad jump
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 3 reps — Reset between sets; stop if landing quality drops.

exercises.name: Easy downshift
exercises.detail: 5 min — 3-8 min easy walk, breathing downshift, then brief comfortable mobility. Long static stretching is optional after the session, never forced.

exercises.name: Box jump or broad jump
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 3 reps — Full reset between quality reps. Beginners use a low box or controlled broad jump.

exercises.name: Back squat or trap-bar deadlift
exercises.detail: 4 sets · 5 reps — 3-4 sets of 3-6 controlled reps. Beginners use fewer sets and lighter loading.

exercises.name: Barbell or dumbbell RDL
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 6 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-8.

exercises.name: Loaded split squat
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 6 reps — 2-3 sets of 5-8 per side.

exercises.name: Bench press or dumbbell bench press
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 8 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-10.

exercises.name: Pull-up, pulldown, or row
exercises.detail: 3 sets · 8 reps — 2-4 sets of 5-10.

exercises.name: Loaded trunk circuit
exercises.detail: 2 sets · 8 min — 2-3 sets or 6-10 minutes.
